name: use-roving-tablist
title: useRovingTablist
description: Hook that gives a role="tablist" container the ARIA APG roving-tabindex keyboard model: arrow/Home/End move focus and the list keeps a single Tab stop.

docs.lead: A React hook that implements the ARIA Authoring Practices tabs keyboard model over the DOM nodes of a tablist container. Arrow keys move focus between enabled tabs (wrapping, RTL-aware), Home/End jump to the first/last, and the tablist keeps exactly one Tab stop — on the focused tab, otherwise the selected tab, otherwise the first enabled one. Works with tabs that are cloned children of arbitrary depth, which the container cannot address individually.

props.name: containerRef
props.description: Ref to the element carrying role="tablist". Its `[role="tab"]` descendants are the tabs; tabs with `disabled` or `aria-disabled="true"` are skipped.

api.name: useRovingTablist Return Value
api.description: The object returned by the hook.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Keydown handler for the container. Handles ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (direction-aware), Home and End; ignores every other key so activation stays with the native button.

props.name: syncTabStop
props.description: Re-applies the single Tab stop. Called automatically after every render; call it from a ResizeObserver or MutationObserver that already watches the tab nodes.
